title: Here Come the Warm Jets
feel: Layered, repeating electric guitars (instrumental), about 4 minutes

sections.name: Main loop
sections.note: Shapes named in E; with the guitar tuned down they sound in E♭.

why: **Half-step-down tuning** and **building a multi-part arrangement**: loop the rhythm (record it or use a pedal) and play the slide lines over it.
hard_change: **F♯5 → G♯5 → A5** in a bar and a half at full volume.
theory: I–V–II–III–IV: the major II and III roots give a Lydian lift, implied only (power chords).
steps: Tune down a half step. The loop alone, slowly.
With the rhythm at 70%, then the lead lines: guitar 3 slides 14–11–9–7–4–7, guitar 4 slides 9–7–5–2–5.
With the record, layering parts over your own loop.
caveat: Only one tab states the tuning; the progression agrees across both sources.
